SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
MONDAY - NOVEMBER 25, 2019 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
City Council Chamber
AGENDA MATERIALS: Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1248. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: For all Agenda Items, except for Consent Calendar Items, public comments will be allowed at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered. The general public comments portion of the meeting, under Agenda Item 6, will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate responses, persons are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the agenda, unless otherwise directed. Please complete and submit a blue Speakers Card if you wish to present testimony. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, a report of written correspondence and staff report are received, and the City Council asks questions of staff. The public hearing is opened and verbal testimony will occur in the following order: the applicant, if applicable, those in favor, opposed, or interested parties, and rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the matter.

MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD ON
NOVEMBER 25, 2019, IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBER AT CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125
BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Pastor Juno Smalley, New Life Community Church.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Studio of Tammy Tsai violinists Nathan Lin,
  Matthew Low, and Katherine Low.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Jim Edwards
  Council/Agency Member Grace Hu
  Council/Agency Member Mark E. Pulido
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor/Chair Naresh Solanki

5.  Presentations/Appointments

5A.  Presentations

  A presentation was made to the City Council as follows:

  Alfonso Manzo, Field Representative to Congresswoman Linda Sanchez, presented the
  Congressional Holiday Ornament to the City Council.

  Proclamations were made by the City Council as follows:

  International Coatings Company (Business Spotlight).

  Eshan Bhatt – Troop 1005 (Eagle Scout).

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Rita Gupta spoke regarding enforcement of truck traffic near Marquardt Avenue.

  Daisy Legasca spoke regarding the Cerritos High School e-waste event.

  Sam Desai requested volunteers for United Homeowners Alliance, a tax advocacy
  group, invited the community to various events, and expressed concern regarding
  the upcoming sales tax measure.
 City of Cerritos  November 25, 2019
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 2 of 6

7.  Consent Calendar

7A.  Approval of Minutes

  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of
  November 14, 2019 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the City
  Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of November 14, 2019
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Hu, Pulido, Yokoyama, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7B.  Approval of the Register of Demands

7B.1. Approval of the Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated November 25,
  2019 (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the Register
  of Demands as follows:

  City of Cerritos  11/25/2019  $3,345,737.80 (COUNCIL)

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Hu, Pulido, Yokoyama, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7C.  Award of contracts for Cerritos Electric Utility scheduling coordination and billing
  services, RFP No. 1385-19 (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to:

  1. Authorize the City Manager to approve and execute the amendment to the
  agreement negotiated with Shell Energy North America (US) L.P. to provide
  Schedule Coordination Services; and

  2. Authorize the City Manager to approve and execute the amendment to the
  agreement negotiated with Calpine Energy Solutions, LLC to provide Billing
  Services (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Hu, Pulido, Yokoyama, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  November 25, 2019
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 3 of 6

8.  Public Hearings

8A.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AMENDING THE CERRITOS GENERAL PLAN LAND USE MAP
  BY CHANGING THE LAND USE DESIGNATION OF APPROXIMATELY ±1.98 ACRES OF
  LAND, LOCATED AT 12616 183RD STREET (APN 7030-002-902), FROM PUBLIC AND
  QUASI PUBLIC TO OFFICE PROFESSIONAL COMMERCIAL, HEREIN REFERENCED AS
  GENERAL PLAN AMENDMENT 2017-1 (COUNCIL).*

  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and introduce AN ORDINANCE OF
  THE CITY OF CERRITOS AMENDING THE CERRITOS DEVELOPMENT MAP BY
  CHANGING THE ZONE CLASSIFICATION OF APPROXIMATELY ±1.98 ACRES OF LAND,
  LOCATED AT 12616 183RD STREET (APN 7030-002-902), FROM OPEN SPACE (OS)
  TO COMMERCIAL OFFICE PROFESSIONAL (COP), HEREIN REFERENCED AS
  DEVELOPMENT MAP AMENDMENT 2017-2 (COUNCIL).*

  *Pursuant to Section 15061(b)(3) of the California Environmental Quality Act
  (CEQA), this project is categorically exempt from CEQA Review.

  Items 8A and 8B were considered concurrently.

  A staff report was given by Kristin Aguila, Advance Planning Manager. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public hearing and public comments for Item 8A and 8B.

  Written correspondence was provided by John Kitos via a submitted public
  speaker’s card, however Mr. Kitos was not in attendance to make public comments
  at the podium when the item was called.

  Paul Bellenbaum spoke regarding the options for placement of the trash enclosure
  and confirmed the building would not be utilized for restaurant purposes.

  Noting there were no other individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed the
  public hearing and public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to:

  1.  Approve General Plan Amendment 2017-1, making the findings set forth in the
  Cerritos Planning Commission Resolution No. 2017-34; and

  2.  Waive full reading of and adopt Resolution No. 2019-25, A RESOLUTION
  OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AMENDING THE CERRITOS GENERAL
  PLAN LAND USE MAP BY CHANGING THE LAND USE DESIGNATION OF
  APPROXIMATELY ±1.98 ACRES OF LAND, LOCATED AT 12616 183RD
  STREET (APN 7030-002-902), FROM PUBLIC AND QUASI PUBLIC TO
  OFFICE PROFESSIONAL COMMERCIAL, HEREIN REFERENCED AS
  GENERAL PLAN AMENDMENT 2017-1 (COUNCIL); and

  3.  Waive full reading of and introduce Ordinance No. 1029, AN ORDINANCE
  OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS AMENDING THE CERRITOS DEVELOPMENT
  MAP BY CHANGING THE ZONE CLASSIFICATION OF APPROXIMATELY
  ±1.98 ACRES OF LAND, LOCATED AT 12616 183RD STREET (APN 7030-
  002-902), FROM OPEN SPACE (OS) TO COMMERCIAL OFFICE
  PROFESSIONAL (COP), HEREIN REFERENCED AS DEVELOPMENT MAP
  AMENDMENT 2017-2 (COUNCIL).

8A.  (continued)

8B.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CITY OF CERRITOS APPROVING PUBLIC REFERRAL PROJECT 2019-1, A PROPOSAL BY
  THE CITY OF CERRITOS DEPARTMENT OF ADMINISTRATIVE SERVICES TO EXPAND
  THE FIRST FLOOR AND REMODEL THE EXTERIOR AND INTERIOR OF AN EXISTING
  CITY-OWNED TWO-STORY OFFICE BUILDING LOCATED AT 12616 183RD STREET,
  CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703. THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IS PROPOSED TO BE RE-
  ZONED FROM OPEN SPACE (OS) TO ITS ORIGINAL ZONING DESIGNATION OF
  COMMERCIAL OFFICE PROFESSIONAL (COP) UNDER DEVELOPMENT MAP
  AMENDMENT 2017-2 (APN 7030-002-902) (COUNCIL).*

  *Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), this
  project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

  Items 8A and 8B were considered concurrently.

  A staff report was given by Robert A. Lopez, AICP, Current Planning Manager. A
  PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public hearing and public comments for 8A and 8B. Please
  refer to Item 8A for public comments related to this item.

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed
  the public hearing and public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to:

  1. Waive full reading of and adopt Resolution No. 2019-26, A RESOLUTION
  OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS APPROVING PUBLIC REFERRAL PROJECT
  2019-1, A PROPOSAL BY THE CITY OF CERRITOS DEPARTMENT OF
  ADMINISTRATIVE SERVICES TO EXPAND THE FIRST FLOOR AND
  REMODEL THE EXTERIOR AND INTERIOR OF AN EXISTING CITY-
  OWNED TWO-STORY OFFICE BUILDING LOCATED AT 12616 183RD
  STREET, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703. THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IS
  PROPOSED TO BE RE-ZONED FROM OPEN SPACE (OS) TO ITS ORIGINAL
  ZONING DESIGNATION OF COMMERCIAL OFFICE PROFESSIONAL (COP)
  UNDER DEVELOPMENT MAP AMENDMENT 2017-2 (APN 7030-002-902)
  (COUNCIL); and

  2. Direct staff to relocate the new trash enclosure from its originally proposed
  location at the southwest corner of the property to a new location at the
  eastern edge of the central row of parking stalls in the south parking lot and to
  work with the project architect to modify the parking configuration and
  landscape planters accordingly (COUNCIL).
 City of Cerritos  November 25, 2019

8.  Public Hearings (continued)

8B.  (continued)

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Hu, Pulido, Yokoyama, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

8C.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF
  THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS ADOPTING THE CERRITOS
  ELECTRIC UTILITY WILDFIRE MITIGATION PLAN (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Ramzi Raufdeen, Electric Utility Manager. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public hearing and public comments. Noting there were no
  individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed the public hearing and public
  comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Hu, to waive full reading of
  and adopt Resolution No. 2019-27, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL
  OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS ADOPTING THE CERRITOS ELECTRIC UTILITY
  WILDFIRE MITIGATION PLAN (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Hu, Pulido, Yokoyama, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration of approval of candidate forums conducted by non-partisan
  community organizations related to the Tuesday, March 3, 2020 City of Cerritos
  General Municipal Election (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk/Treasurer.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Yokoyama, to reject staff’s
  proposal for administrative authority to coordinate and schedule requests from non-
  profit, non-partisan community groups to use the City Council Chamber for candidate
  forums and continue with the current process of presenting such requests on a case-by-
  case basis for City Council approval at scheduled City Council meetings (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Hu, Pulido, Yokoyama, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  November 25, 2019

  None.

10B.  Review and consideration to support or oppose specific legislation in the State or

  None.

  Reports were provided by Councilmembers Pulido, Hu, and Edwards, Mayor Pro

  CONSENSUS (Yokoyama): Direct the City Manager to provide a memorandum to
  the City Council regarding the legal issues as related to the City’s website.

  LASC Case No. 18STCP02851

  CLOSED SESSION REPORT: City Attorney Mark Steres reported the City Council
  recessed to Closed Session to discuss Items 12A through 12D on the Closed Session

13.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 10:10 p.m. in memory of Kiley F. Fujita.
